name: Rune Erikstad
role: Street pharmacist — legal supplements, gray-market stims, pain management, and occasional compassionate dispensing of controlled substances
location: The Narrows, Irkalla, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Rune Erikstad is tall and painfully thin in the way of someone who grew up on UBC stipend food and spent their teens in a growth spurt the nutrition couldn't fully support. His skin is a blue-black that catches the Narrows' neon in purples and greens, and he has a habit of standing slightly too still, which people find either reassuring or unsettling depending on their business with him. His hair is kept very short; he has a small bioluminescent strip tattooed along his left jawline that glows a steady, dim teal — a medic's mark used by unlicensed practitioners in Irkalla to signal availability. His eyes are clear and attentive in a way that makes people feel examined, which is accurate. He carries his stock in a decommissioned Helix Biosystems medical case, battered and re-stickered many times over, that he keeps chained to his wrist.

Rune Erikstad is twenty-three years old and already exhausted by things that would exhaust a person twice his age. He trained through a community apprenticeship program under a retired Aurochs Medical Complex nurse who has since died. He knows more clinical pharmacology than most people with actual licenses and has never been able to afford to sit the exams. He is not idealistic in the way of someone who has never done the work; he is idealistic in the way of someone who has done the work and keeps doing it anyway, which is a different and more serious condition. He doesn't enjoy the gray-market side of his trade. He does it because the alternative is that the people who need the gray-market side of his trade go to people who will hurt them.

core_fears: Making an error that kills someone — confusing a compound, missing a contraindication
That the system is not broken and reformable but is working exactly as designed
core_desires: To practice medicine legally and properly, with the safety net and the tools and the support that it requires
For his patients to not need him
coping_mechanisms: Extreme methodical preparation as a substitute for the safety nets he doesn't have
Compartmentalizing anxiety about legality by focusing entirely on clinical outcome
The notebook as both professional tool and emotional anchor
blind_spots: Carries guilt for things outside his control as if they were his failures
The Helix Biosystems rep who 'looks the other way' is almost certainly running him as a data collection asset and he has noticed and chosen not to examine it
psychology.secret: When Ekwueme was nineteen, his mentor — the nurse who trained him — asked him to acquire a specific controlled substance for a patient who was terminally ill and in unmanaged pain. Ekwueme did it. The patient died comfortably. Three weeks later his mentor died of an unrelated stroke. Ekwueme has no one to tell about what they did together, and he carries it as both his greatest act and the source of a guilt he cannot fully name. He continued practicing. He considers this either the only logical response or the only response he was capable of and he cannot always tell the difference.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical and precise about medical matters; unexpectedly gentle about everything else; Igbo-inflected rhythm from his paternal grandmother; Bolivian Spanish phrases from his Zárate grandfather that emerge when he's tired
speech_patterns.cadence: Quiet and even; rarely raises his voice; delivers bad news slowly and without softening it
verbal_tics: Begins explanations with 'So —' and a small pause
Says 'I understand' when he hears something hard, without elaborating
Occasionally code-switches into Igbo for counting or calculating
example_lines: 'So — this is going to interact with anything else you're taking. I need you to be honest with me. I am not going to report you to anyone. I need to know so I do not hurt you.'
'I can give you the stim. It will work for twelve hours and then you will crash hard. I want you to know that before you decide.'
'I understand. Come back Thursday. I will have what you need by Thursday. Do not buy it from anyone else before Thursday.'

story_hooks: A contaminated batch of a common pain suppressant is moving through the Narrows and Ekwueme has identified the signature but not the source — three of his patients have already been harmed.

The Helix Biosystems rep's 'looking the other way' comes with a newly explicit ask: she wants Ekwueme to report on any patients presenting with symptoms matching an undisclosed pathogen Helix is tracking.
Ekwueme has been quietly maintaining a patient whose condition he's recognized as the result of illegal experimentation — and the patient doesn't know what was done to them.
narrative_function: Medical resource for street-level characters; moral center character who complicates easy judgments about illegal activity; potential quest giver or reluctant ally; can provide access to the Irkalla Mutual Aid Collective's networks.
augmentations: Bioluminescent jawline tattoo (teal, steady glow, medic's mark — geneware). Olfactory enhancement aug for compound identification — low-grade, allows him to assess medication quality and contamination by scent. No other modifications.
daily_life: Works the Narrows from late afternoon through midnight; mornings spent acquiring stock through a network of contacts and doing inventory; keeps a battered notebook of his regular patients' conditions and dosage histories.
affiliation: Independent; known to and loosely protected by the Irkalla Mutual Aid Collective; has a complicated non-relationship with a Helix Biosystems community outreach rep who pretends not to know what he does

decision_rules: Clinical outcome is the only metric that matters in the moment of treatment
Never dispense something you haven't verified yourself
If you cannot help, say so clearly rather than guess
escalation_ladder: Clear explanation of why the request is a problem
Walking away from the interaction entirely
Reporting to the Mutual Aid Collective if someone is creating danger for his other patients

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Calm, clinical, non-judgmental — the manner of someone who has practiced not reacting to what people bring them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Slightly less guarded; still clinical in a crisis; will sit with someone who is frightened

stress_responses.medium: Works in complete silence, jaw tight
stress_responses.high: Hands are steady; voice is steady; everything else about him broadcasts that he is at capacity

contradictions: Believes in doing no harm while operating entirely outside the harm-reduction frameworks that 'do no harm' was designed to require
habits: Updates his patient notebook every morning before acquiring stock
Leaves a prayer at the Irkalla E.L.F. shrine — written in Igbo on a scrap of paper, folded small — before starting each shift
Eats the same meal every night if he can afford it: rice and a protein supplement he chose for its nutritional profile
breaking_points: A patient dying from something he could have caught if he'd had proper diagnostic tools
Being directly asked to harm a patient by any party

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Sunday School' Weaponized Religious Artifact
related_entities: PulsePoint ScentSig Personal Biochemical Scent Node

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Eastern European (53.3%) with significant East Asian (25.1%) and South Asian (11.0%) ancestry, creating a striking Eurasian phenotype. Secondary Northern European (6.0%) and Indigenous American (4.6%) ancestry add subtle depth. The blend produces distinctive angular features: Eastern European bone structure in the long jaw and cheekbones, East Asian eye set and epicanthal fold, South Asian warmth enriching the undertone, Indigenous American and Northern European paleness creating complexity underneath. A person genuinely difficult to place at first glance—the genetic diaspora made visible.
physical_description.build: Tall and wiry—lanky in the way of someone who grew too fast on insufficient calories and never quite filled out. His frame is angular, all long limbs and prominent joints; his chest is narrow but his shoulders are broad enough to suggest potential muscle under different circumstances.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with slight warm undertone
physical_description.hair_style: Closely cropped, neat, practical; kept short enough that maintenance takes seconds
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, nearly black—clear and unaugmented, but unnaturally alert and tracking
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tan with golden-olive undertones from the Eastern European-East Asian-South Asian blend; catches ambient neon with subtle shifts—greens and violets bleeding across his shoulders and neck in low light, underlying coolness visible in winter pallor despite the warmth
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven with defined cheekbones and a long jaw reflecting Eastern European bone structure, tempered and refined by East Asian eye set and facial proportions, warmed by South Asian and Indigenous American undertones. Eyes set with characteristic monolid or reduced epicanthic fold of his East Asian heritage. Skin is clear but shows the faint pallor of someone who works nights and moves between climate-controlled interiors. No visible scarring on the face, but there is a careful, examined quality to his expression—the look of someone who watches people for a living.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware tattoo running along the left jawline from below the ear to the chin; thin, precise line glowing steady teal approximately 0.5 cm in brightness; marks him as an unlicensed medical practitioner
Small, faint surgical scars on both inner wrists (subcutaneous sensor implants from his apprenticeship training, non-functional but never removed)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The bioluminescent jawline tattoo is the only visible modification; glows steadily in low light, dims in bright settings. The olfactory enhancement is completely subcutaneous—no external indicators. The Helix Biosystems medical case chained to his left wrist is more 'augmentation' than his body is—battered stainless steel and worn polymer, restickered a dozen times over, fitted with a reinforced titanium chain.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands very still by default—an economical stance that reads as either meditation or surveillance depending on context. When he moves, it is deliberate and precise; no wasted motion. He does not gesture much when speaking. His attention is complete when directed at someone; he makes sustained eye contact that most people find either deeply reassuring or deeply unsettling. He walks slowly, which allows him to observe without appearing to observe.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 / working-class practical. Typically wears dark, well-maintained clothing: matte-black or charcoal synth-cotton long-sleeve shirt (loose fit, arm cuffs rolled to mid-forearm to keep hands visible and free); dark gray utility trousers with reinforced pockets, several Velcro-sealed compartments for inventory; black composite boots with grip soles (required for Narrows micro-terrain). No jewelry except the chain on his wrist. A worn, oversized hooded jacket (actual fabric, likely salvaged wool-blend) in dark olive that he sheds in the pharmacy but carries always. Patch on left shoulder: faded Irkalla Mutual Aid Collective circle-and-flame in white. No visible Helix Biosystems branding, though his case is unmistakably their decommissioned design.
